prompts.title: Library Solitude
prompts.prompt:
Create a 4K photorealistic cinematic portrait of a man reading a book in a quiet library aisle, standing beside a tall wooden bookshelf filled with hardcover books. He is gently leaning his left shoulder and upper back against the bookshelf in a relaxed posture.
Match the face, hairstyle, and beard (if present) from the reference image. He has black rectangular eyeglasses, and a calm academic appearance.
He is wearing:

a taupe chunky rib-knit cardigan with large buttons
a light blue Oxford button-down shirt
beige chino trousers
a dark brown leather belt
The man is holding an open hardcover book with both hands at chest level, looking down at the pages with a focused, neutral expression.
Lighting:

Soft indoor library lighting, overhead fluorescent or LED strip lights providing even illumination, gentle top-down light on subject’s face and hands, minimal shadows, neutral-to-warm color temperature, softly lit bookshelves in background, shallow depth of field, calm academic atmosphere, natural ambient interior lighting, realistic cinematic photography.
Composition details:

Eye-level camera angle
Three-quarter view
50mm portrait lens
f/1.8 aperture
Shallow depth of field
The left bookshelf appears slightly out of focus in the foreground, creating foreground depth blur.

The subject remains sharply in focus.
Ceiling dark blue green color.
The background contains blurred bookshelves and ceiling lights with creamy bokeh, creating a warm academic atmosphere with cinematic realism.
No other people present in the scene. Empty library aisle.
Natural color grading, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, 4K quality.
Aspect ratio: 4:5
